en: The image shows a vintage postcard with two sepia-toned photographs depicting scenes of daily life in a traditional village setting. Both photographs feature stone buildings, wooden structures, and villagers in early 20th-century attire. One photo shows people standing on a balcony and in an archway, while the other shows a group with a donkey in a narrow street. The text on the postcard is in French and Greek, indicating a location in the Peloponnese region of Greece, specifically Andritsena.
